claims.claim: Benchmark tracking by Dynamic Yield indicates that the shopping cart abandonment rate for the Food & Beverage ecommerce category reached 82.76%.
The Sovos ShipCompliant Direct-to-Consumer Wine Shipping Report recorded a drop exceeding $230 million in shipped value in 2025, alongside an 11% increase in the average price per bottle shipped.
Research on choice overload shows that presenting excessive product choices leads to increased cognitive load, decision fatigue, and higher cart abandonment.
A study by Sheena Iyengar and Mark Lepper found that displaying 6 choices yielded a 30% purchase rate, whereas displaying 24 choices resulted in only a 3% purchase rate.
Shopify's Product Recommendations API categorizes recommendations using the parameters 'related' for similar items and 'complementary' for paired cross-sell goods.
Shopify's Product Recommendations API supports a returned item limit of 1 to 10 products and advises displaying 2 to 3 complementary products by default.
